title: Enriched assisted living residences (EALR) and special needs assisted living residences (SNALR).
officialText:
In enriched
assisted living residences (EALR) and special needs assisted living residences (SNALR) licensed by the New York State Department
of Health, at least ten percent, but not less than one, of the dwelling units and sleeping units shall be Accessible units. The remainder
shall be Type B+NYC units with all grab bars installed where grab bar reinforcements are required.
